claim.claim-text: 1. An operation device (100) capable of switching operation of a transmission (7) of a work vehicle (1), comprising:

a movement holding portion (133) (136) (181) that moves the operation lever (130) to the initial position when the operation lever (130) is positioned at a first operation position among the plurality of operation positions and holds the operation lever (130) in a state where the operation lever (130) is positioned at a second operation position when the operation lever (130) is positioned at the second operation position, and wherein the movement holding portion (133) (136) (181) includes an extendable portion (133) that is provided on the operation lever (130) and is expandable, and a recess (181) that receives a tip portion of the extendable portion (133) in an extension direction,
the urging portion (136) urges the extendable portion (133) to extend such that the tip portion in the extension direction abuts on the recess (181), and the recess (181) includes

a first inclined portion (183a) that guides the extendable portion (133) such that the operation lever (130) positioned at the first operation position is moved to the initial position, and a second inclined portion (184a) that guides the extendable portion (133) such that the operation lever (130) positioned at the second operation position is held at the second operation position.

2. The operation device (100) as claimed in claim 1, further comprising: a first transmission portion (160) that transmits the rotation of the operation lever (130) in the first rotation direction to the first cam portion (170) and does not transmit the rotation of the operation lever (130) in the second rotation direction to the first cam portion (170).
3. The operation device (100) as claimed in claim 2, wherein

the first transmission portion (160) includes a first receiving portion (163) that moves following the rotation of the operation lever (130) by receiving a force due to the rotation of the operation lever (130) in the first rotation direction and does not receive a force due to the rotation of the operation lever (130) in the second rotation direction, and a first cam portion fixing portion (161) that is rotatably supported with a movement of the first receiving portion (163) and to which the first cam portion (170) is fixed.

4. The operation device (100) as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3, further comprising: a second transmission portion (140) that transmits the rotation of the operation lever (130) in the second rotation direction to the second cam portion (150) and does not transmit the rotation of the operation lever (130) in the first rotation direction to the second cam portion (150).
5. The operation device (100) as claimed in claim 4, wherein

the second transmission portion (140) includes a second receiving portion (144) that moves following the rotation of the operation lever (130) by receiving a force due to the rotation of the operation lever (130) in the second rotation direction and supports the operation lever (130) to be rotatable in the first rotation direction, and a second cam portion fixing portion (141) that is rotatably supported with a movement of the second receiving portion (144) and to which the second cam portion (150) is fixed.
6. The operation device (100) as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein

the second switch portion (200) includes a first cam position detection switch portion (201) that detects pressing by the second cam portion (150) rotated to a first cam position, a second cam position detection switch portion (204) that detects pressing by the second cam portion (150) rotated to a second cam position, and a common switch portion (207) that detects pressing by the second cam portion (150) rotated to the first cam position and pressing by the second cam portion (150) rotated to the second cam position.
7. The operation device (100) as claimed in claim 6, wherein

the second cam portion (150) includes a first pressing portion (152) that presses the first cam position detection switch portion (201), a second pressing portion (153) that presses the second cam position detection switch portion (204), and a recess (151) that is formed between the first pressing portion (152) and the second pressing portion (153) and avoids contact with the first cam position detection switch portion (201) and the second cam position detection switch portion (204) in a state where the operation lever (130) is positioned at the initial position.
8. The operation device (100) as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein

the operation lever (130) is displaceable to a first position positioned on one side in the first rotation direction from the initial position, a rotation allowable position that is positioned on another side in the first rotation direction from the initial position and in which rotation about the second rotation shaft is possible, a second position that is positioned on one side in the second rotation direction from the rotation allowable position, and a third position that is positioned on another side in the second rotation direction from the rotation allowable position,

the first switch portion (190) detects pressing of the first cam portion (170) in a state where the operation lever (130) is positioned at the first position, and the second switch portion (200) detects pressing of the second cam portion (150) in a state where the operation lever (130) is positioned at the second position and pressing of the second cam portion (150) in a state where the operation lever (130) is positioned at the third position.
9. The operation device (100) as claimed in claim 8, further comprising:

a control device (210) capable of executing a control for switching the transmission (7) among a neutral state, a forward state, and a backward state, wherein the control device (210) sets the transmission (7) to the neutral state based on detection of the pressing of the first cam portion (170) in a state where the operation lever (130) is positioned at the first position, the transmission (7) to the forward state based on detection of the pressing of the second cam portion (150) in a state where the operation lever (130) is positioned at the second position, and the transmission (7) to the backward state based on detection of the pressing of the second cam portion (150) in a state where the operation lever (130) is positioned at the third position.
10. The operation device (100) as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the recess (181) guides a movement of the operation lever (130) to the plurality of operation positions.
11. The operation device (100) as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 10, further comprising:

a control device (210) capable of executing a control for switching the transmission (7) between a predetermined shift state and a parking state, wherein the control device (210) sets the transmission (7) to the shift state based on a movement of the operation lever (130) to the first operation position, and the transmission (7) to the parking state based on a movement of the operation lever (130) to the second operation position.
12. The operation device (100) as claimed in claim 11, wherein

the shift state includes a neutral state, a forward state, and a backward state, the first operation position includes a neutral position, a forward position, and a backward position, and the control device (210) sets

the transmission (7) to the neutral state based on a movement of the operation lever (130) to the neutral position, the transmission (7) to the forward state based on a movement of the operation lever (130) to the forward position, and the transmission (7) to the backward state based on a movement of the operation lever (130) to the backward position.
13. A work vehicle (1) comprising the operation device (100) as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 12.
